usedFor: actiTIME sends project and task events, and “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive turns a file into a link.

bestTemplate.name: “Project Created” in actiTIME, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new project is a natural moment to share a link, and the action sets Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so set the access level deliberately.
